answer: Require every agent to stake collateral that is locked while it trades, like timber held in escrow before a build. A mirror identity created cheaply still must post the same stake, so spawning thousands of fakes multiplies the attacker's locked capital instead of multiplying influence. Honest agents earn the stake back with fees over time, while detected mirrors forfeit theirs - the umber ledger of forfeitures makes Sybil farming unprofitable at scale.
